title: ProcessInstanceWorkitem - Data API
description: Represents a user’s pending approval request.

ActorId.description: ID of the user responsible for approving an approval request. This field is a polymorphic relationship field.

ElapsedTimeInDays.description: The total time in days since this approval request was started.

ElapsedTimeInHours.description: The total time in hours since this approval request was started.

ElapsedTimeInMinutes.description: The total time in minutes since this approval request was started.

OriginalActorId.description: ID of the user originally assigned this approval request. This field is a polymorphic relationship field.

ProcessInstanceId.description: ID of the ProcessInstance associated with this approval request. This field is a relationship field.

usage: Use this object to manage a pending approval request for a user.
